intro.h2: A remodeler that settles the plan first
paragraphs: Five Fold Solutions handles bathroom remodeling in Overland Park and across Johnson County from its office on Lamar Avenue. The team's view is simple: most remodel problems start before demo day, with unclear scope, rushed selections and poor communication. So the scope, budget and schedule are agreed first, and the build comes second.

Every job opens with a 10 to 15 minute phone call, then an on-site walkthrough if the project looks like a fit. You get updates on a set schedule, changes in writing and a structured final walkthrough. Since launching in March 2024, the company has completed more than 120 projects.

items.name: Kitchen Remodels

about.h2: Started by two friends from a church men's group
about.text: Five Fold Solutions began when Max Farmer and Jason Luce met through a church men's group and found they shared the same view of how building should be done. Jason brought years of hands-on craftsmanship and field experience. Max brought a background in business strategy, systems and operations. They launched in March 2024 and grew from a small network of trusted trades into a fuller team. Today Max leads the business side and Jason leads clients and production, from the first conversation to the final walkthrough.

process.h2: From first call to closeout in five steps

steps.title: Tell us about the room
steps.text: Share the space, the problems you want solved and what is prompting the remodel, by phone or through the contact form.

steps.title: A 10 to 15 minute call
steps.text: Priorities, general scope, location and timing are discussed, along with whether the project looks like a good fit for the team.

steps.title: On-site walkthrough
steps.text: If it is a fit, the team visits to look closely at the room, its existing conditions and the practical options.

steps.title: Scope, planning and selections
steps.text: Layout, materials, fixtures and trade needs are worked into a defined scope and price before any agreement is signed.

steps.title: Build, then closeout
steps.text: Five Fold manages schedule, materials and trades with regular updates, then finishes with a walkthrough and a clear record of the work.

service_area.h2: Johnson County towns on our schedule
service_area.text: Five Fold works out of 6310 Lamar Ave in Overland Park and takes projects across Johnson County and the Kansas City metro. Bathroom clients come from Overland Park, Leawood, Prairie Village, Mission Hills, Fairway, Lenexa, Shawnee and Olathe, and the footer of the site adds Louisburg, Edgerton and Bonner Springs. Not sure your street is covered? Put the project address in your message and the team will confirm on the first call.

items.q: How do I start a bathroom remodel with Five Fold?
items.a: Call (913) 904-6400 or send the contact form with a short note about the room. The first step is a 10 to 15 minute phone call about your goals, timing and general scope. If the project looks like a good fit, the next step is an on-site walkthrough of the bathroom.

Yes. Five Fold's Google Business Profile invites homeowners to schedule a free consultation, and its outdoor living pages offer a complimentary site walk-through. Pricing for the remodel itself comes later, once the scope, layout and selections are defined, so the number you sign reflects the work that was actually agreed.

items.q: Can you turn my tub into a walk-in shower?
items.a: Often, yes. Tub-to-shower conversions are on the bathroom scope list when they suit the room, along with walk-in showers, layout changes, custom tile, shower niches and new vanities. The team looks at plumbing, ventilation and the existing conditions during the walkthrough before recommending it.

items.q: What drives the cost of a bathroom remodel?
items.a: Five Fold names six drivers: room size and access, layout changes and plumbing moves, the shower system and its glass and tile, storage and vanity details, lighting and ventilation needs, and the finish level of fixtures, tile and flooring. Instead of quoting a range up front, the team prices the scope once the room is understood.

items.q: Are you licensed and insured, and who handles permits?
items.a: Five Fold Solutions is a licensed contractor, fully insured and a BBB Accredited Business. Permit and trade coordination is part of the project management the team provides, along with sequencing, quality review and final detailing, so you are not left calling the city or chasing subcontractors yourself.

final_cta.h2: Talk through your bathroom in 15 minutes
final_cta.text: Call Max and Jason's team at (913) 904-6400 for a short first conversation, or send your project details and the address and they will set up the next step.
